spec.description:
Bradford Fibertex is a range of robust, non-combustible rockwool
(stone wool) industrial insulation boards and blankets engineered for
high-temperature and fire-critical applications. Manufactured by spinning molten
natural basalt rock and recycled slag into fine inorganic fibres bonded with a
thermosetting resin, Fibertex operates continuously at service temperatures
from 350°C up to 820°C with minimal shrinkage. It provides thermal conservation,
fire protection, condensation prevention, and acoustic absorption for industrial
process vessels, tanks, furnaces, fire-rated curtain walls, and building
envelopes.

install:
Clean and inspect the hot vessel, duct, or framing surface to ensure it is free
from grease, loose scale, and water

Weld insulation pins or studs to the
substrate surface at recommended centres (typically 300mm to 450mm)

Impale
the Fibertex boards or blankets firmly over the pins with the unfaced side
against the hot surface

Secure boards in place using non-corrosive metal
speed clips / washers pushed over the pins

Butt all board edges tightly
together to eliminate thermal bridging and acoustic leaks

For piping or
curved vessels, secure using wire mesh, steel banding, or metal sheet cladding

Trim neatly around flanges, nozzles, and structural penetrations using an
insulation saw or knife
selection_checklist:
Determine maximum
continuous operating temperature (≤350°C select 350; ≤450°C select 450; ≤650°C
select 650; ≤820°C select 820)

Confirm required density and mechanical
load-bearing capacity

Check required thickness for personnel protection
(touch temperature < 60°C) or process thermal control

Verify compatibility
with stainless steel surfaces (confirm ASTM C795 low chloride compliance)
Select facing if needed (plain unfaced, foil faced, or wire mesh faced)
limitations:
Do not exceed maximum continuous
service temperature rating for the selected grade (350°C, 450°C, 650°C,
or 820°C)

Dense grades (Fibertex 820) are semi-rigid and do not conform
easily to tight curved surfaces without pre-cutting

Outdoor installations
must be clad with metal jacketing or weatherproofing cladding to prevent water
pooling

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford
Fibertex is a heavy-duty, non-combustible rockwool (stone wool) board and
blanket range engineered for high-temperature industrial equipment, fire-rated
curtain walls, and acoustic enclosures. Spun from natural volcanic rock and
recycled slag in densities from 60 kg/m3 (Fibertex 350) up to 130 kg/m3
(Fibertex 820), it withstands continuous service temperatures up to 820°C with
minimal thermal shrinkage. Certified non-combustible to AS 1530.1 and complying
with ASTM C795 low-chloride standards for stainless steel, it delivers
industrial thermal conservation, personnel protection, and acoustic absorption.
